claim: If a Direct PUT stream is throttled because ingest exceeds its throughput capacity, Amazon Data Firehose automatically increases the throughput limit of the stream until the throttling is contained. This can take time, so producers should keep retrying the failed records.
question: What happens when a Direct PUT Firehose stream is throttled, and what should the producer do?

values.display: automatically increases the throughput limit of the stream

qualifiers.condition: if you expect sudden large bursts or need more than the default throughput, request a limit increase

evidence.quote: If a Direct PUT stream experiences throttling due to higher data ingest volumes that exceed the throughput capacity of a Firehose stream, Amazon Data Firehose automatically increases the throughput limit of the stream until the throttling is contained. Depending on increased throughput and throttling, it might take longer for Firehose to increase the throughput of a stream to the desired levels. Because of this, continue to retry the failed data ingest records.
